rationale: The pain is real but the evidence base is thin: a single HN post with 7 points and 6 comments is the only primary signal, and willingness to pay for a separate monitoring layer on top of an existing subscription is unconfirmed. Competing free browser extensions and platform-native dashboards undercut the paid-product thesis, and no competitor pricing, forum discussion volume, or 'is there a tool for this' request pattern was found to meet the 5-distinct-quotes and 1-WTP-signal bar required for pass.
